scenarios.name: Packet loss on a fabric link
scenarios.description: Drop a share of the payments crossing one fabric link. Loss on the shared fibre span degrades one region only; loss on the rail leaves payments in UNKNOWN.
scenarios.blast_radius: Every payment whose route crosses the named link. FIB-7 affects region-b's primary route only.

scenarios.name: Settlement rail latency
scenarios.description: Add latency to the shared settlement rail, which both regions cross.
scenarios.blast_radius: Both regions: the rail is the one link neither route can avoid.

scenarios.name: Shrink the ledger connection pool
scenarios.description: Reduce a region's ledger connection pool so payments queue for a connection. Shows as latency first and errors later, which is what a saturation incident really looks like.

scenarios.name: Delay the config apply
scenarios.description: Make the config registry take longer to apply a change than the caller is prepared to wait, so a rollback times out on the caller and still succeeds on the harness. This is how an UNCERTAIN execution is produced on purpose.
scenarios.blast_radius: Config applies only. Payment traffic is untouched.

scenarios.name: Take a regional gateway down
scenarios.description: Hard-down one region's gateway link. Every payment entering that region fails immediately.
scenarios.blast_radius: One region's entire inbound payment path.
